jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Program Coordinator is the primary administrative support for the local site. During recruitment, program coordinators manage incoming nominations, the interview schedule, and student personal information through Salesforce. Additionally, program coordinators provide logistical support for each phase of the interview process, as well as the Award Ceremony, and often take the lead in organizing volunteers. During Pre-Collegiate Training, program coordinators play a key role in managing the Writing Program and coordinate logistics for special events such as summer retreats and the Posse Olympics. In support of the Campus Program, program coordinators collect and organize student data and assist program directors in producing regular reports. Program Coordinators also manage travel logistics and supplies for special events on campus. In addition to these responsibilities, program coordinators provide general support for the local office such as managing calendars, tracking office supplies, answering phones, and welcoming students and guests. The program coordinator reports directly to the program director of the site.

* Bachelor’s Degree required
* Excellent writing skills
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to multi-task
* Excellent presentation and communication skills
* Excellent time-management skills
* Experience with youth is a plus
* Ability to work well with college students
* Able to work autonomously and within a team
* Event management experience a plus
* Proficiency required in MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, internet and email
* Proficiency in Adobe InDesign and MS Access a plus
* Proficiency/Knowledge of Salesforce a plus
* Knowledge of design software
* Bilingual a plus
* Demonstrated belief in Posse’s mission and values

jobs.title: Aerial Arts Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the role**

Los Gatos Elite's Aerial Arts program has a strong lead coach and a solid support staff. What we need now is someone to round out the team: a capable coach who also enjoys the organizational side of running a program.

Our aerial program includes:

* Recreational Aerial Silks
* Recreational Aerial Hoop/Lyra
* Competitive/Performance Hoop and Fabric

You'll coach across these levels and take ownership of the behind-the-scenes work that keeps the program running — scheduling, registrations, parent communication, and competition logistics — in partnership with our lead coach and LGE leadership.

**What your week looks like**

* **10–12 hours coaching** – recreational silks and hoop/lyra classes, plus support for competitive/performance team training
* **3–5 hours admin** – class rosters and scheduling, parent emails, competition registrations and entry fees, travel planning, showcase and event coordination
* **Travel for competitions** – accompany the team to aerial competitions and performances (dates shared in advance)

**Responsibilities**

* Coach recreational silks and hoop/lyra classes with safe, consistent progressions
* Assist the lead coach with competitive/performance training, conditioning, and act preparation
* Maintain the aerial class schedule, rosters, and enrollment records
* Serve as a primary point of contact for aerial families on schedules, fees, and competition details
* Manage competition registrations, entry fees, travel arrangements, and day-of logistics
* Coordinate with support coaches on coverage and class needs
* Follow and reinforce LGE's safety and rigging standards
* Represent LGE's culture of respect, growth, and teamwork with athletes, families, and staff

**What we're looking for**

* Solid experience in aerial silks/fabric and hoop/lyra as a coach and/or performer
* Experience coaching youth, from beginners through competitive/performance level
* Strong organizational and communication skills; comfortable with email, spreadsheets, and scheduling tools
* Someone who likes being the person who keeps things on track
* Working knowledge of aerial rigging and safety practices
* Available for competition travel, including some weekends
* Choreography or performance experience a plus
* Must pass and maintain a green light background check; CPR/First Aid certification (or willingness to obtain) required
* Must be able to stoop, bend, climb, and lift 50 pounds overhead

**Why LGE**

Los Gatos Elite is a gymnastics, ninja, and aerial training academy with a close-knit coaching team and a culture built on perpetual growth, respect, and teamwork. This is a role with real responsibility and a clear path to grow as the program does. Our aerialists perform in LGE's annual Showcase alongside our gymnastics and ninja athletes.

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Work Location: In person

**Build What Matters Most—Families, Futures, and Your Career**

Enjoy meaningful work while contributing to an organization that changes lives every day. **US Fertility**, the nation’s leading partnership of physician-led fertility practices, is redefining what it means to build a career in reproductive medicine.

Our team members choose to build their career home at US Fertility because of the **hope we inspire in our patients**, the **lives we help bring into the world**, and the **culture of excellence we foster across our organization.** We share a deep commitment to continuously improving the patient experience and advancing research and development in one of the most dynamic and impactful fields of medicine.

Through our national network of premier fertility centers—including **Reproductive Science Center of the San Francisco Bay Area**—we combine clinical expertise, scientific innovation, and compassionate care. The work we do building families offers purpose, challenge, and personal reward—and we’re just getting started.

**Opportunity Overview**

We have an immediate opening for a **Patient Navigator** to join our team at **Reproductive Science Center of the San Francisco Bay Area** in **Menlo Park, California.**

Whether collaborating with more than **200 highly respected physicians nationwide** or partnering with colleagues who are passionate about solving meaningful problems, you’ll be surrounded by a team committed to shared success.

* Establish a compassionate environment by providing excellent customer service, anticipating anxieties, answering questions, providing support

**What You’ll Bring**

We’re looking for professionals who bring both technical skill and a deep sense of responsibility to the care experience—individuals who thrive in environments where excellence, empathy, and accountability matter.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Operations** **Manager**
--------------------------

**Position Classification**: Exempt, full-time, benefits eligible

**Accountable to:** Program Director

**Operations Manager Position Description:**

Under the direct supervision of the Program Director, the Operations Manager (OM) works collaboratively with all staff to facilitate and supervise the orchestration of daily operations related to client treatment and care on behalf of the Program Director and clinical team under the auspices of all prevailing Pathway Society policies and procedures. The Operations Manager reports and documents major incidents and concerns around documentation, workflow, client needs, staff performance, and crisis interventions to the director. The OM is a problem solver who can delegate, resolve, direct and instruct staff and clients in a respectful, positive, and goal-oriented fashion. The Operations Manager is responsible for the initial mediation, crisis prevention/intervention and maintaining *daily* workflow. While the OM is the first contact in the milieu, they do not create, change, or decide the interpretation of policies, curriculum, infractions, discharges, or staff disciplinary actions.

**Operations Manager Primary Responsibilities**:

* Work with care coordinators (CC), withdrawal management staff, reception, and intake to refine client movement and communication amongst team members and clients.
* Work with clinical teams to manage CCs client relationships.
* Report and answer directly to program director on daily issues and concerns related to CC, counselors, and client care.
* Collaborate with clinical supervisor daily to assist clinical team.

* Assist in facilitating medical needs for staff and clients with nurse and doctor in a timely fashion; communicate with medical, clinical and transport for client daily concerns; and Organize med and transport and fill in as needed.
* Conduct daily facility inspections for cleanliness, general condition, and damage.
* Be an ambassador by being visible for client and staff contact within the milieu.
* Broadly ensure the status of linen, toiletries, sanitation supplies and collaborate with culinary staff for any emerging needs.
* Collaborate and assist clinical, medical, intake and WM needs with county services, RR/OP, health agencies as needed including ALOC, transition, and referrals.
* Facilitate peer groups as necessary during clinical team absence or clinical crisis interventions.
* On a periodic basis, fill in during emergency scheduling issues that have no other staffing resolution available.
* Inspect CC work for compliance with PSI documentation and required paperwork.

Conduct shift change meetings (counselors train CC on techniques for client interaction).

* Refine daily client schedule to remove obstacles for groups, meals, breaks, transit, family visits, and drop offs.
* Review daily LOG of scheduled events not in the daily client treatment schedule and coordinate activities as necessary.
* Navigate and delegate daily crisis concerns with staff and resolve issues for staff to maintain workflow, client care, and productivity.
* Recognize initial conflicts with staff, clients and staff, client to client relations, and direct them to clinical team or director for resolution as necessary.
* Document all incidents with staff and/or clients and refer to the program director.
* Report any breech PSI policies by staff or clients to director; concerns with staff needs; and infractions and disciplinary issues.
* Monitor staff and client compliance within PSI policies, paperwork, procedures and intervene with redirection towards proper interaction, procedure, compliance, and workflow.
* Under the direction and guidance of the program director, create a training binder and maintain weekly staff training for procedures and paperwork, emotional regulation strategies, motivational interviewing trauma-informed techniques, meeting people where they are at, positive employee behavior, navigating technology, and professional affect policies.
* Under direction of the program director, consolidate PSI paperwork to decrease confusing clutter and increase workflow performance.
* Audit client case files for county compliance as necessary and directed.

**Operation Manager Qualifications:**

* Clinical experience and degree required
* CADC/equiv. and/or Bachelor's degree required
* Experience working with mental health and substance use disorder populations required.
* Ability to work peacefully and cooperatively as a member of the team.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills including use of computerized word and electronic health record data base.
* Ability to work effectively with people differing in value systems, ethnicity, cultural backgrounds, language capabilities, and disabilities.
* Mastery of utilizing tact and diplomacy in disputes; exercising good judgment; and responding calmly in emergency situations.
* Must pass comprehensive background check, reference check, and possess a valid driver license, current auto liability insurance and a clean driving record.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; climb stairs; walk; use hands to finger, handle, and type and occasionally lift supplies, up to 20 pounds.

**Other Duties**

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, activities and scheduled shift may change at any time, with or without notice.

jobs.title: Operations Manager (Utility Design)
jobs.description:
**OPERATIONS MANAGERAbout Radius Design**

Radius Design is a growing Bay Area utility design and consulting firm specializing in dry utility, electric, gas, and joint trench design. We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to help us build efficient systems, improve coordination, and keep our growing organization running smoothly.

**The Opportunity**

The Operations Manager owns the day-to-day operations of the company, working under the COO and closely with leadership, project management, engineering, design, and administration to ensure our people, processes, priorities, and resources are aligned.

This is a heavily operations-driven leadership role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, creating structure, improving processes, and bringing clarity to ambiguous situations. The ideal candidate is an influential, solutions-oriented leader who can bring teams together, make thoughtful decisions, lead change, and remain calm when things get complicated.

**If you are someone who can bring calm to complexity, turn ambiguity into clarity, and help both people and operations work better, we’d love to hear from you.**

**What You'll Do**

* Partner with the COO and leadership team on operational strategy, organizational needs, and company-wide initiatives.
* Lead organizational and process changes by creating clear expectations, communicating effectively, and ensuring follow-through.
* Identify complex operational problems, determine root causes, and develop practical solutions that improve how teams and processes work together.
* Bring teams together to resolve process gaps, improve accountability, and strengthen handoffs between departments.
* Turn ambiguous situations into clear expectations, processes, and accountability.
* Recognize when something isn't working, challenge the status quo, and bring leadership thoughtful, actionable solutions.
* Step into escalated project, client, or team situations when leadership involvement is needed and help drive issues toward resolution.
* Support hiring, onboarding, employee development, performance conversations, and team development.
* Oversee training programs and communicate department needs to the Training Manager to ensure new hires get the support they need.
* Provide informed feedback on new hires during training and confidently recommend when a candidate is not the right fit.
* Reinforce Radius Design's core values of **Teamwork, Integrity, Commitment to Clients, Quality, and Employee Wellness.**
* Own and improve day-to-day operational processes, workflows, and systems.
* Monitor team workload, capacity, priorities, utilization, and operational metrics, while avoiding ownership of day-to-day scheduling and break-in work.
* Establish and maintain processes for priorities, urgent requests, handoffs, and operational accountability.
* Partner with the Operations Analyst and Project Coordinator to maintain effective operational systems, reporting, and coordination.

**Who You Are**

You are an **operations leader first who also happens to be great with people.**

You are:

* A strong critical thinker and creative problem solver who enjoys figuring out complex "puzzles."
* Calm and effective in high-intensity, high-stakes situations.
* Highly conscientious and naturally aware of the cause and effect decisions can have across teams, projects, clients, and the business.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and skilled at creating structure where none exists.
* Influential and collaborative, with the ability to bring people together around solutions.
* Willing to challenge the status quo and speak up when something isn't working.
* Comfortable making decisions, holding boundaries, and having difficult conversations when necessary.
* Caring and approachable, while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.
* Someone who genuinely cares about employee growth and success without becoming the person employees use as a therapist.
* Able to understand organizational dynamics and recognize the strengths and core competencies already within the team.
* A strong change leader who can help people understand and successfully adopt new expectations and processes.
* Solutions-oriented: you don't just identify problems—you come prepared with ideas for how to solve them.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, business administration, or a related field.
* Experience leading people, processes, or operational initiatives.
* Strong problem-solving, organizational, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Experience with change management and process improvement.
* Some experience with HR functions, employee development, onboarding, performance management, or hiring.
* Experience in engineering, construction, architecture, utilities, or professional services is a plus.
* Experience with Asana or similar project management systems is a plus.
* Six Sigma or other continuous improvement experience is a plus.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $120,000.00 - $135,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Education:

Experience:

jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit’s Mid-Market organization is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Generation Analyst to drive deep insights across the demand generation funnel. This role will be responsible for analyzing performance from first touch through lead routing and handoff, identifying leakage, uncovering trends, and ensuring every lead is properly tracked, routed, and acted upon. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical rigor, operational curiosity, and a passion for improving funnel efficiency through data-driven insights

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze the end-to-end demand generation funnel for Intuit’s Mid-Market business, from lead creation through routing, acceptance, and downstream outcomes.
* Identify funnel leakage, drop-offs, and inefficiencies, and clearly quantify the business impact of gaps in process, execution, or data.
* Conduct deep-dive analyses into lead routing and disposition, ensuring leads are correctly assigned, tracked, and followed through to resolution.
* Develop and maintain reporting and dashboards that provide clear visibility into funnel health, conversion rates, velocity, and lead outcomes.
* Partner closely with B2B Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, and Sales teams to diagnose issues, validate findings, and recommend corrective actions.
* Analyze trends over time to surface emerging risks, opportunities, and shifts in lead behavior or performance.
* Ensure data integrity across systems (e.g., marketing automation, CRM), proactively flagging discrepancies, data loss, or process breakdowns.

* Support experimentation and optimization efforts by measuring the impact of campaigns, routing logic changes, and process improvements.

* Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Business, Economics, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, demand generation analytics, revenue operations, or a related analytical role.

* Advanced proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
* Experience working with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot, Eloqua).
* Demonstrated ability to investigate ambiguous problems, trace issues across systems, and identify root causes.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership for data accuracy and outcomes.

Mountain View $166,500 - $225,500

Our Tablet Product Operations organization drives innovation in consumer electronics, bringing exciting products from concept to customer hands. jobs.title: Fire Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
**About BurnBot**  
BurnBot provides systematic fuels treatment services to prevent destructive wildfires. We're firefighters, scientists, engineers, prescribed fire practitioners, ecologists, and community members who are answering the call to scale fuel treatment capacity. Our modern fuel treatment system recognizes and supports conservation efforts with a clean, smoke-free process. We need technology to amplify our workforces with targeted use of synthetic fire to treat fuel loads 10x faster than previously possible.

  

**The Role**  
BurnBot is seeking a Fire Operations Specialist (FOS) to perform middle leadership oversight within the Fire Program. This role mixes supervisory oversight of BurnBot Fire Modules with responsibility for field-based project operational oversight as well as performing client-focused tasks.

  

This role, while in the field a majority of the time, may be based in Placerville, CA, Medford, OR, or our South San Francisco, CA Headquarters.

  

Administrative tasks include day to day management of 5-person Fire Modules. The FOS will have primary responsibility for recruitment and retention of 1-3 Modules as well as performing supervisory duties including onboarding, ensuring administrative tasks are carried out to BurnBot standards, providing performance feedback, coordinating training, and providing direction leadership in lieu of the Module Leader when they are unavailable. The FOS will help to coordinate Module mobilizations as well as their own in coordination with other FOS and Fire overhead.

  

Field based tasks will include:

* Planning for and/or execution of prescribed fire (broadcast burning, pile burning, air curtain burning, RX2/PFV burning, etc)
* Module leadership for wildfire mobilization and/or mobilization coordination across multiple types of equipment (Type 5 or 6 engines, chippers, heavy equipment, etc)
* Conducting or coordinating Defensible Space Inspections
* The FOS is expected to serve as a project manager/POC or Burn Boss for field projects and maintain a consistent field presence to support Fire Modules, evaluate conditions, and ensure alignment between planning and execution.

* Performs job walks and field verification for proposal building
* In coordination with organizational stakeholders, ensure all projects comply with OSHA, environmental regulations, and fire requirements
* Maintains day-to-day relationship touchpoints at the site and project level
* Captures issues early and escalates effectively through the Fire Director staff or Program leads
* Maintains project artifacts including scope documentation, maps/GIS inputs, schedules, and acceptance checklists
* Other duties as assigned

  

Administrative Tasks:

* Customer management including developing and maintaining relationships with current and potential clients.
* Help to develop proposal budgets, project implementation schedules, and scopes of work.
* Unique skills and qualifications that the FOS possesses will be incorporated into their workload as needed for related BurnBot work.

  

The FOS splits time approximately 40/60% between administrative responsibilities and field engagement. This role serves as the critical operational bridge between Fire Modules and the Director Staff level.

  

This is an exempt role with a salary of $123,000 to $140,000 per year. Placement within the range depends on experience, certifications, and skills.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Directly oversee and support Fire Modules across multiple crews and/or project sites including directly managing modules as needed
* Ensure consistent execution of company standards related to safety, quality, productivity, and professionalism
* Provide guidance, direction, and corrective action to Fire Module leadership
* Maintain oversight of safety performance across all assigned operations
* Ensure compliance with burn plans, project plans, safety policies, and regulatory requirements
* Review incidents, near misses, and safety reports; implement corrective actions and improvements
* Reinforce stop-work authority and risk management expectations at all levels
* Own and manage all required operational reporting (i.e. Production, Safety, Equipment, Labor, Budget, etc.)
* Participate in job walks, pre-bid site visits, and scope development
* Support long-range operational planning, including staffing needs, equipment acquisition, and seasonal workload balancing
* Serve as a primary point of contact between field operations and BurnBot Directors
* Other duties as assigned

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Ability to travel extensively (up to 60%)
* Valid driver's license and ability to be insured under company policy (this role requires driving company vehicles and trailers to remote job sites)
* Minimally qualified as an NWCG ENGB or CRWB, ICT5, and RXB3
* 5+ years of experience in forestry, fuels mitigation, vegetation management, or wildland fire operations in the public or private sector
* Demonstrated experience supervising fire crews or foremen
* Experience working with public agencies and regulatory bodies
* Strong working knowledge of prescribed fire operations, wildfire operations, and field safety standards
* Proven ability to manage reporting, documentation, and operational planning
* Physical ability to perform demanding field work (lifting up to 50 lbs, uneven terrain, long days outdoors)

  

Desired Qualifications

* Any of the following NWCG certifications: FIRB, RXB2/1, CRWB, ENGB, TFLD, DIVS, ICT4
* Experience in wildland firefighting and prescribed burning
* Experience operating farm, forestry, or other heavy equipment, trucks and large trailers
* Experience supporting proposal development and estimating
* Bachelor’s Degree in Forestry, Fire Science, Natural Resources, or related field
* NFPA Certified Wildfire Mitigation Specialist
* GIS Data Analysis

  

Still interested? Please apply at BurnBot.com/Careers or by sending your resume to careers@burnbot.com.

*

jobs.description:
**Background**

The California Institute for Regenerative Medicine (CIRM) is a state agency created by California voters to accelerate stem cell and gene therapies for people with unmet medical needs. Since 2004, Californians have entrusted CIRM with $8.5 billion to accelerate promising discoveries through clinical trials, train a regenerative medicine workforce, strengthen the state’s biotechnology economy, and expand access to transformative treatments. Today, CIRM is pioneering new models of therapy development and accelerating medical breakthroughs that change lives, in California and around the world. For more information, visit www.cirm.ca.gov.

  

**Position Summary**

CIRM is seeking a highly organized and experienced Program Manager for Program Development and Operations to support the planning, development, and effective operation of CIRM's scientific programs.

  

Reporting to the Chief Science Officer (CSO), the Program Manager works across CIRM's Programs organization to coordinate program development, improve operational consistency, track major activities and decision points, and identify issues that require attention or resolution. The position works closely with Program Leads, Project Managers and partner functions, including Review, Grants Management, Legal, Finance, Communications, and IT/Software Development.

  

The Program Manager provides operational management and direction within established processes and, in coordination with the CSO identifies where new or improved processes are needed and supports their development and implementation. The position maintains an integrated view across program areas, identifies gaps and dependencies, brings issues forward early, and helps ensure decisions are translated into clear actions and follow-through.

  

This role requires someone who can work across multiple teams, make sense of complex and sometimes competing priorities, and bring structure and clarity without adding unnecessary process.

  

**Job Functions**

Program Development and Funding Cycle Coordination

* Coordinate the development and implementation of new and revised funding programs, working across Program teams, Review, Grants Management, Legal, Communications, and other functions.
* Maintain visibility across major funding-cycle activities and decision points, including concept development, eligibility, application review, programmatic recommendations, governance review, launch, and implementation.
* Coordinate timelines, dependencies, responsibilities, and required inputs across functions. Identify gaps or potential delays early and work with responsible teams to resolve them.
* Support the development of Program concepts, Program Announcements (PAs), Request for Applications (RFAs), amendments, implementation plans, and related materials, while ensuring primary content ownership remains with the appropriate Program and functional teams.
* Coordinate operational readiness for Executive Team, Science Subcommittee, Board, and other governance review of Programs activities, ensuring materials, recommendations, timelines, and required decisions are clear and appropriately coordinated.
* Track significant decisions through implementation and coordinate resulting actions, timelines, and operational changes.
* In coordination with Program Manager (Strategy and Operations) responsible for tracking outcomes of CIRM funding, aggregating to CSO and incorporating it back into funding cycles where needed.

  

Cross-Program Operations

* Maintain an integrated view of major priorities, timelines, dependencies, and operational risks across Discovery and Education, Preclinical Development, Clinical Development and other Programs activities as they relate to funding cycles.
* Work with Program Leads and PMs to identify operational gaps, clarify responsibilities, improve coordination, and support timely execution.
* Identify issues that require CSO attention and provide summaries of the issue, implications, recommended next steps, and decisions needed.
* At the direction of the CSO and in coordination with Program Leads, develop and implement operational expectations and common practices across Programs.
* Identify operational risks, cross-functional dependencies, unclear ownership, and process gaps related to funding cycles; work with responsible teams to identify options and resolve issues, and bring significant or unresolved matters to the CSO early with recommended next steps.
* Track agreed actions and decisions through implementation, particularly where responsibilities cross Programs or organizational functions.

  

Operational Planning and Process Improvement

* Assess how funding cycle efforts are being carried out across Programs and identify practical opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, accountability, and visibility.
* Develop and maintain appropriate operating tools for funding cycles, including integrated plans, dashboards (excluding Review cycle trackers), decision and action trackers, templates, SOPs, and common workflows.
* Help distinguish between funding cycle processes that should be standardized across Programs and those that appropriately remain specific to individual program areas.
* Support implementation of agreed funding cycle process changes and assess whether they are working as intended.

Where state and federal laws/regulations allow, accountable for performing day-to-day non-clinical pharmacy operations, administrative activities; Ensures efficient pharmacy workflow and a positive patient experience. Serves as a full-time certified pharmacy technician. Responsible for operating pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions. Under the supervision of a pharmacist, supervising pharmacy technicians and pharmacy cashiers within the guidelines of authorized company policies, laws, regulations and business ethics. Responsible for the selection, scheduling, and development of pharmacy technician personnel. Leads training, coaching, and performance management of pharmacy technicians. Makes decisions regarding performance management including discipline and termination.
  
  
**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer complaints, helps respond to customers’ requests in a timely manner and answers non-clinical questions to ensure a positive customer experience. Models and shares customer service best practices.
* Develops strong relationships with customers by anticipating customer needs and proactively offering services to provide the best experience possible when using the pharmacy. Enhances customer experience by increasing focus on healthcare services.

**Operations**

* Responsible for assisting pharmacist in the delivery of patient care including patient registration, prescription data entry, preparation of medications for patients, counting, and verifying (where allowed by law). jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Operations Manager**

**Full-time**

**Onsite**

**Department: Operations**

**Reports to: General Manager**

**FLSA: Exempt**

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**WHO WE ARE:**

At **Sky Zone**, our mission is to enrich lives through the power of boundless play — whether that’s on the trampoline court, behind the scenes, or at the corporate level. We believe play fuels confidence, connection, and joy, and we’re proud to create experiences that reflect that purpose in everything we do.

As the leader in active indoor entertainment, we host unforgettable birthdays, team events, and school parties across the country. Backed by our parent company, CircusTrix, and recognized as a top franchise and growth brand, we continue to raise the bar for innovation and impact in the industry.

Our culture is shaped by our core values: We **Play Without Limits**, **Ignite Innovation**, **Grow Together**, **Fuel Joy**, and **Serve Big, Give Bigger**. Whether in a park or a boardroom, these values guide how we lead, collaborate, and show up for each other and for the communities we serve.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**WHO YOU ARE:**

You’re the glue, the guide, and the go-to. A natural leader who thrives in motion, you balance coaching with accountability and set the tone every shift. When things get busy, you stay steady supporting your team, solving problems, and making sure the energy never drops.

You know how to lead from the floor and manage behind the scenes. Whether it’s creating a great schedule, coaching in real time, or stepping into the action, you bring intention, care, and hustle to everything you do.

**HOW YOU BRING OUR MISSION TO LIFE:**

Lead Daily Execution and Team Success

* Supervise Team Leads and frontline team members during scheduled shifts.
* Coach in real time to build a team culture of accountability, energy, and care.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and training efforts.

Own Shift Flow and Operational Efficiency

* Oversee daily park execution — including staffing, guest flow, inventory, and cleanliness.
* Collaborate with the GM on labor strategy, scheduling, and safety procedures.
* Adapt to real-time challenges to keep operations smooth and seamless.

Deliver Guest Experiences That Wow

* Ensure guests feel welcome, safe, and supported from check-in to check-out.
* Lead guest recovery when needed and train the team to respond with urgency and empathy.
* Support birthday parties, special events, and high-volume guest flow with confidence.

Champion Safety and Brand Standards

* Conduct safety walkthroughs and support compliance across all park zones.
* Maintain clean, well-functioning facilities and hold the team to brand standards.
* Lead by example to create a worry-free, play-filled environment for all.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM:**

You’ve got the experience to lead confidently and the mindset to lead with care. We’re looking for someone who brings:

* **Minimum of 2–3 years of formal management or supervisory experience,** including direct responsibility for leading teams, ideally in a high-volume, guest-facing industry such as hospitality, entertainment, retail, fitness, or restaurants.
* **Experience overseeing daily operations,** managing teams on the floor, and adapting to shifting priorities in real time
* **Strong communication skills**, you give feedback with care, build trust quickly, and know how to coach in the moment
* **Comfort with scheduling, labor targets, and supporting operational goals**; you understand how day-to-day execution impacts the bigger picture.
* **A hands-on leadership style,** you're not above jumping in to solve a problem, run a shift, or set the tone on a busy day.
* **Comfortable using technology and operational systems**, with basic proficiency in Microsoft Office, POS platforms, scheduling tools, and reporting dashboards; quick to learn and apply new systems in daily operations.
* **Availability** to work evenings, weekends, and holidays – when the park (and the magic) is most alive.

**WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS:**

As Operations Manager, you're the one who keeps the park in motion. You help the team thrive, support guest joy, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You’re a steady presence, a quick thinker, and the calm in the storm.

This role is your chance to lead with energy, impact, and heart and to help build something unforgettable, one bounce at a time!

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

***Compensation range is $70,304 (+ bonus)*** *based on qualifications, experience, and performance. Full-time employees at CircusTrix enjoy a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage along with a 401k plan with company matching. Eligibility for 401k is based on age and tenure requirements.*

  

***Application deadline: 11/30/2026***

*While we anticipate the application window will close on this date, Sky Zone reviews applications on a rolling basis and will consider candidates until the position is filled.*

***CircusTrix and its brands are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.***

Department Overview
  
  
Welcome to Electric Asset Strategy (EAS). We are responsible for asset strategy, standards, procedures, and end-to-end risk management for 2.3 million structures across the electric distribution system. We deliver risk-informed strategic plans that leverage inspection insights and asset data to guide maintenance and investment decisions.
  
  
The Distribution Asset Risk Management (ARM) team—comprising Asset Failure Analysis (AFA), Asset Insights, and Inspections & Maintenance Strategy (I&M)—focuses on continuously improving how PG&E monitors and maintains its assets to support a resilient, reliable grid and help keep our communities safe.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Program Manager, Expert will lead the development, implementation, and financial stewardship of I&M strategy programs for PG&E’s electric distribution assets. The role will translate regulatory requirements, asset condition insights, risk analysis, budget planning, accounting considerations, and operational constraints into executable multiyear strategies and work plans that improve safety, reliability, compliance, affordability, and risk-spend efficiency.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Service Repair Quality
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla is seeking a Program Manager to own North America Service repair quality. The focus of this work is changing from all customer comebacks to 3x comebacks: customers who return three or more times. This role makes that number one the field trusts, finds why those cars come back, and changes the process and the behavior that cause the return. You will not own the repair, the diagnosis engine, or the parts catalog. You will partner across Field, Training, Field Technical Support, Warranty, and Analytics so a failed repair becomes rarer, not just better documented.

The ideal candidate is credible with technicians, has the grit to stay on a stubborn comeback number, and the horsepower to separate a bad repair from a bad part, a bad process, or a bad handoff.

This role is based in Palo Alto, CA or Austin, TX, for proximity to Service Engineering, Training, and partner teams. It reports into Service Operations.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own Tesla Service repair-quality performance for North America, with the focus shifting to 3x comebacks, and run the plan that moves that metric
* In the first 30 days, learn the repair path end to end — from the correction on the visit through parts, the work itself, quality check, delivery, and the visit that comes back — in the tools and in a service center
* In the first 60 days, make the 3x comeback metric trustworthy: definition, source, owner, and what counts as a third return versus a single comeback, a new concern, a parts delay, or a customer choice
* Find the systemic drivers: standard work, handoff from diagnosis, parts, site process. Do not stop at “the technician missed it”
* Identify the technicians, sites, and habits that are actually movable, and drive adoption. A note in the bulletin is not a result
* Build one view with Business Analytics so the field, Training, and leadership are looking at the same repairs
* Partner with Field Technical Support, Training, Warranty, and Service Engineering without waiting for a perfect org chart; Report regularly to senior leadership on the number, what was tested, and what is next

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Track record of taking an untrusted quality or comeback metric and making it clean enough that the people who do the work will use it
* Has ramped on a repair, warranty, or field-service operation — tools and shop floor — in about 30 days. Sat with the people who do the job, not only read the process
* Changed technician or site behavior on quality, with a clear view of who, where, and what actually moved. Coached, did not police
* High EQ with technicians and managers. Can push a hard quality number without making the shop the enemy
* Sharp analytical horsepower: finds the real driver in noisy repair data. Comfortable with SQL or similar, and can size an opportunity on the spot
* 5+ years of program or operations management, ideally in automotive service, field service, warranty, or repair quality
* Exceptional verbal and written communication, including comfort presenting to senior leadership; Willingness to travel up to 25% to service centers

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program

$108,000 - $162,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. ### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Intellectual Property Law, Environmental Science, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of professional experience in the electronic consumer product scrap and recycling industry.
* 2 years of experience in asset disposition.
* 2 years of experience in a management or program leadership role.
* Experience in vendor performance management and contract administration.
* Experience developing and deploying security programs around confidential prototypes and unreleased products.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* R2, CSDS (Certified Secure Destruction Specialist) or CPP (Certified Protection Professional).
* Experience with "demanufacturing" processes—knowing exactly how to take apart a proprietary device to extract value without compromising secrets.
* Deep understanding of and experience in loss prevention/asset protection, conducting security risk assessments, physical security systems and processes, investigations, and corrective action planning (CAPA), writing and implementing security standards, along with basic understanding of EHS work flows and waste control regulations.
* Demonstrated high ethical standards with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately, with excellent judgment, discretion, and diplomacy.
* Ability to travel domestically or internationally.

**About the job**
-----------------

We are seeking a Global Destruction Program Manager to design, implement, and oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our most sensitive physical assets. This is not just a waste management role; it is a critical security function. You will be responsible for ensuring that prototypes, defective/decommissioned high-value components, proprietary pieces of hardware, devices, components and materials are rendered non-recoverable. You will lead a global network of certified vendors, ensuring that our intellectual property never leaks, ends up on the secondary market or in the hands of competitors.

From keeping Googlers safe and secure to managing disruptive events, the ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act are the pillars of Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team. As a member of GSRS you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $157000 - $227000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and maintain global Secure Destruction SOPs aligned with security leadership, ensuring compliance with international trade, local laws, and data privacy regulations.
* Source, manage, and physically audit global destruction, smelting, and recycling partners via unannounced site visits to guarantee compliance.
* Classify critical Alphabet IP to define destruction standards, deploying RFID/GPS tracking to maintain end-to-end chain of custody through final certification.
* Conduct risk assessments, threat benchmarking, and lead investigations into asset leaks, theft, or grey-market breaches alongside cross-functional stakeholders.
* Leverage AI tools and program metrics to drive operational efficiency, scale secure workflows, and continuously modernize scrap destruction practices.

**Organization:** Compass Family Services is a 100+ year old nonprofit working on the front lines of San Francisco's homeless crisis. We provide families experiencing or at risk of homelessness with comprehensive support to address immediate needs and ensure long-term success.

**Program:** Compass's early childhood programs include 3 center-based programs tailored to meet the specific needs of children living in extreme poverty and homelessness. Together, the programs serve over 200 children ages 0-5 and their families each day. They address the social, emotional, cognitive, language, physical development, and special education needs of the children, as well as the functioning and well-being of the families. e community garden. These are all supported by our highly-qualified teaching staff and a wide variety of age-appropriate teaching tools.

**Salary:** $80,000 - $90,000 annually. Full time exempt.

  

**Organizational Core Competencies:** Accountable / Adaptable / Client-centered / Collaborative / Committed to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging / Resourceful

**Role Description:**  
The Special Education Care Coordinator ensures that children enrolled at Holy Family Day Home, Compass Children's Center, and Helen Hawk receive appropriate and timely special education and inclusion services. This role serves as the primary liaison between families and the San Francisco Unified School District (SFUSD), Golden Gate Regional Center (GGRC) and service providers. They lead families through the referral and evaluation process while ensuring compliance with special education laws and mandated timelines.

*Key responsibilities include:*

* Coordinate special education services for enrolled children to ensure timely access to appropriate supports.
* Serve as a liaison with SFUSD, Golden Gate Regional Center (GGRC), children's physicians, and other relevant agencies and service providers.
* Develop and maintain systems for tracking all developmental concerns and referrals across multiple childcare sites.
* Guide and support families through the full referral and evaluation process, clearly explaining each step and providing ongoing communication.
* Work closely with the Speech and Language Pathologists and Early Interventionists to ensure access to all needed services for students.
* Ensure that transitions from GGRC (IFSP) to SFUSD (IEP) are completed in a timely manner.
* Collect, review, and submit required documentation in accordance with legal and program requirements.
* Maintain strong knowledge of special education laws, regulations, and legally mandated timelines to ensure compliance.
* Build and maintain relationships with local service providers to facilitate timely access to evaluations and services.
* Review ASQ screening data in Sparkler and collaborate with teaching staff and families to determine and initiate appropriate referrals.
* Partner with teaching staff to monitor progress and ensure continuity of care and services.

**Qualifications:**

* BA degree and 1 year of experience in Child Development, Mental Health, Special Education or related fields or AA degree and 2 years of experience in Child Development, Mental Health, Special Education or related fields.
* Experience working with low-income and/or homeless population preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of special education: the IEP process, 504s, and IFSPs.
* Bilingual in Spanish strongly preferred
* Excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as a part of a team.
* Knowledge of child development and assessment of young children's social and emotional functioning preferred.
* Proficiency with basic computer programs including Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Excel. Salesforce experience a plus!
* Experience working with people from diverse racial, cultural, and socio-economic backgrounds.
* Must pass LiveScan fingerprinting process and background check.
* Demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging work.

jobs.title: Client Services Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION / TITLE:** Client Services Coordinator

**RESPONSIBLE TO:** Manager, Home Delivered Meals (HDM) Client Waitlist & Communications

**STATUS:** Non-exempt, Full Time, M-F 8:00am-4:30pm

**PROGRAM ADDRESS:** 2142 Jerrold Avenue, San Francisco, CA 94124

**MISSION:**

Meals on Wheels of San Francisco provides a network of services that allows seniors to live in their homes with dignity and independence as long as possible.

**ABOUT MOWSF:**

MOWSF is committed to the belief that all seniors have the right to live independently with dignity and respect in their own homes, for as long as safely possible. It is our mission to provide isolated homebound seniors in San Francisco with nutritious meals, daily human contact, and supportive services to prevent their premature institutionalization.

**Position Summary:**

The Client Services Administrative Coordinator provides client communication, administrative, and operational support across assigned MOWSF programs, supporting Home-Delivered Meals (HDM). This position serves as a point of contact for clients, caregivers, drivers, staff, and community partners; coordinates service inquiries, provides timely follow-up; and maintains accurate client information in Salesforce and other designated systems.

The coordinator assists with service changes, delivery questions, documentation, and cross-department communication and issues Drivers encounter during deliveries. Depending on program needs, assignments may include client intake, Safety Board support, driver communications and delivery coordination, spreadsheets, and other administrative activities. The position requires dependability, sound judgment, creative problem-solving, calm demeanor, attention to detail, and the ability to balance phone coverage with deadline-driven work. The coordinator must demonstrate initiative, independently assess situations, identify solutions, and effectively utilize available resources and team collaboration to resolve issues.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Client Communications & Service Support***

* Respond promptly and professionally to incoming calls, emails, and inquiries from clients, caregivers, drivers, service providers, and the public.
* Provide accurate information about program services, meal deliveries, estimated delivery arrival times (ETAs), delivery schedules, and applicable procedures.
* Document and help resolve delivery complaints, missed deliveries, service questions, and client requests; driver issues, follow established scripts and escalation protocols.
* Route time-sensitive or specialized concerns to the Social Worker of the Day, operations, other program staff, or appropriate internal departments, including Human Resources for staff-related matters.
* Use respectful communication and de-escalation skills when assisting individuals with complex or sensitive concerns.

***Client Records & Administrative Coordination***

* Enter, review, and update client information and service requests in Salesforce and other approved systems, maintaining accuracy and confidentiality.
* Process or coordinate temporary suspensions, restarts, cancellations, disenrollments, delivery schedule changes, and other authorized service updates.
* Monitor assigned email inboxes and task queues, track follow-up needs, and complete assigned work within established timelines. Prepare, save, organize, and send professional emails, client notices, letters, spreadsheets, reports, and electronic documents.
* Maintain data logs and spreadsheets, support data entry and quality checks, and assist with reporting or special projects.

***Delivery & Safety Operations Support***

* Communicate with delivery drivers and operations staff to relay client instructions, clarify delivery concerns, and coordinate follow-up.
* Assist with driver confirmation calls, Safety Board coverage, missed-delivery outreach, and related documentation as trained and assigned.
* Escalate potential client safety concerns promptly using established procedures and designated staff contacts.

***Program & Team Support***

* Assist with program intake, enrollment, client starts, and other administrative processes as assigned.
* Coordinate requests with social work, intake, delivery operations, and other departments to support continuity of service.
* Share workload information, offer or request coverage as appropriate, and contribute to a respectful, collaborative office environment.
* Support organizational events, program changes, special projects, and other related
    
  duties as assigned.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Relevant customer service, client support, administrative or similar work experience; an associate degree or equivalent combination of education and experience is preferred.
* Working proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and OneDrive, including drafting emails, editing documents, managing files, and maintaining spreadsheets.
* Comfort with computer-based data entry, learning new applications, and moving accurately between multiple systems during calls.
* Experience with Salesforce or a comparable client relationship management database; familiarity with GetCare, phone systems, or delivery coordination tools is helpful.
* Strong verbal and written communication, professional telephone etiquette, and ability to work with culturally diverse clients and colleagues.
* Demonstrated organization, attention to detail, dependable attendance, task ownership, time management, and ability to meet deadlines while managing competing priorities.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, follow established procedures,
    
  and escalate urgent issues appropriately.
* Ability to work productively and collaboratively in a shared, active office environment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in a nonprofit, social service program, call center, dispatch center, or client-facing administrative setting.
* Bilingual proficiency in Cantonese

jobs.title: Intake Coordinator
jobs.description:
**The Sequoia Difference**

At Sequoia Home Health and Hospice, we’re passionate about our work and take pride in the quality of service we provide. Our community is uniquely diverse, and it’s our aim to fulfill the unique needs of our patients through excellent individualized care.

Our focus is to help facilitate a smooth and safe transition home and provide life-changing service with the amount of care and dignity our patients and their families deserve.

**Sequoia is growing and looking for experienced, compassionate Intake Coordinator to join our team!**

**SUMMARY**

The Intake Coordinator is responsible for managing all aspects of the patient intake process including communicating directly with patients and families, data entry, establishing and maintaining positive relationships with customers and referral sources, responding to customer requests and concerns, facilitating a daily intake stand up meeting, and managing the insurance verification and authorization processes.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* The Intake Coordinator directs all daily patient referral and intake operations including providing direct oversight of the establishment and implementation of intake policies.
* Directs the implementation of improved work methods and procedures to ensure patients are admitted in accordance with policy.
* Establishes and maintains positive working relationships with current and potential referral sources.
* Ensures seamless transition of patients to home care by providing direct oversight of patient education and preparation for home care, plan of care initiation, and coordination of care with multiple service providers.
* Ensures maximum third party reimbursement through direct oversight of insurance verification and authorization processes.
* Maintains comprehensive working knowledge of Home Health contractual relationships and ensures that patients are admitted according to contract provisions.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

* The Intake Coordinator must have healthcare experience, preferably in referrals/intake in a home health environment.
* A nursing background is preferred but not required.
* Demonstrates good communication, negotiation, and public relations skills.
* Demonstrates autonomy, assertiveness, flexibility and cooperation in performing job responsibilities.

**Why Sequoia Home Health?**

Sequoia Home Health **is part of the Cornerstone/Pennant Group** with close to 80 locations throughout the country. **While we are part of a large family, we operate as a local team.** We understand we are nothing without great employees! It is through our team’s dedication to deliver life changing service that we become the “provider of choice” in the community that we serve. **Join a culture of high performers** who are on a mission to create the best Home Health and Hospice agency in the Bay Area!

**What makes us unique** besides our culture of high performers and exceptional care? At Sequoia Home Health, we foster an environment where clinicians and staff members have an unprecedented level of freedom to create and implement the programs that will best serve their patients and communities. We operate with the Core Values of CAPLICO in mind:

* Celebration
* Accountability
* Passion for Learning
* Love One Another
* Intelligent Risk Taking
* Customer Second
* Ownership

We’d love to meet with you if you are passionate about giving exceptional patient care and creating the best Home Health and Hospice agency in the Bay Area!

**Pay Range:** $20 - $28 per hour

The employer for this position is stated in the job posting. The Pennant Group, Inc. is a holding company of independent operating subsidiaries that provide healthcare services through home health and hospice agencies and senior living communities located throughout the US. Each of these businesses is operated by a separate, independent operating subsidiary that has its own management, employees and assets. More information about The Pennant Group, Inc. is available at http://www.pennantgroup.com.

jobs.title: Patient Services Representative
jobs.description:
Supporting Community Healthcare is a rewarding role, come join a wonderful organization! LifeLong Medical Care is looking for a **Patient Services Representative** (PSR) to join our Call Center team in Berkeley. The PSR serve as front-line phone staff and “navigators” for our patients, their caregivers and other healthcare entities in our busy Patient Services Call Center. Answer incoming calls, register patients and schedule appointments, triage calls to different departments including urgent calls, document and task messages and other notes in patients’ Electronic Health Record (EHR). Perform other Patient Services Department duties as needed.

This is a full time, 40 hours/week, benefit eligible position. Bilingual English/Spanish highly preferred.

This position is represented by SEIU-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

*LifeLong Medical Care is a multi-site, Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) with a rich history of providing innovative healthcare and social services to a wonderfully diverse patient community. Our patient-centered health home is a dynamic place to work, practice, and grow. We have over 15 primary care health centers and deliver integrated services including psychosocial, referrals, chronic disease management, dental, health education, home visits, and much, much more.*

*Benefits*

*Compensation: $22/hour. We offer excellent benefits including: medical, dental, vision (including dependent and domestic partner coverage), generous leave benefits including ten paid holidays, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) retirement savings plan.*

*Responsibilities*

* Follows all departmental and organizational policies and procedures, establishes and maintains courteous, cooperative relations with the public, patients, and staff from all departments.
* Ensures and promotes excellent customer service to all internal and external customers.
* Answers incoming calls and responds to all callers’ inquiries; monitors call center queues to ensure calls are answered in a timely manner and executed correctly.
* Utilizes NextGen Electronic Practice Management (EMP) and Electronic Health Record (EHR) for all patient interactions.
* Schedules/reschedules appointments for patients.
* Triages calls based on established procedures including urgent medical calls. Pages health center staff as needed.
* Screens new patients over the phone for eligibility and registers as appropriate.
* Maintains established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for call volume, call duration and call quality in a fast-paced, busy call center that receives over 26,000 calls per month.
* Verifies current demographics and insurance information with every patient, enrolls patients in LifeLong Patient Portal, and updates information in system as necessary.
* Maintains effective written and verbal communication including appropriate and clear communication in patients’ Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Electronic Practice Management System (EPM).
* Answers non-patient incoming calls and requests for information, and transfers to the appropriate department(s).
* Answers questions and provides general information, refers to appropriate resources.
* Assists with training and onboarding of new Patient Services Representatives.
* Performs other related duties as required.

* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills and ability to effectively work with people from diverse backgrounds and be culturally sensitive. Ability to show empathy to patients with complex health needs.
* Excellent customer service skills using a positive, proactive, “can-do” approach.
* Ability to work effectively and calmly under pressure in a positive, friendly manner.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and juggle multiple tasks.
* Strong problem-solving skills, and ability to be flexible and adaptive to change.
* Ability to work in a team-oriented environment with staff with different work and communication styles.

***Job Requirements***

* One (1) year of multi-line telephone experience and/or one (1) year experience as medical receptionist with scheduling and telephone experience.
* High school diploma/GED.
* Demonstrated computer skills with standard office software (MS Office) and typing speed of at least 30 WPM.
* Ability to read and comprehend instructions, procedures, emails and memos.
* Ability to abide by LifeLong’s Organizational Standards for conduct and attendance.
* Knowledge of basic medical terminology.
* Ability to effectively present information verbally and in written communications to patients and staff.

***Job Preferences***

* At least one-year of experience in a healthcare setting preferred including experience in private practice, or a Community Health Center.
* Bilingual English/Spanish highly preferred.

Desired:

* Knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software, SAP enterprise system inventory management system such as SAP to Microsoft

This is a temporary role, anticipated to last 4-6 months. The target base pay for this position is $40 - $60 per hour.

jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Beacon's talent function is scaling fast, running in parallel across corporate functions and a growing roster of independently operated portfolio companies. Supporting each one of those searches are the systems and processes behind it: clean Ashby data, funnel and data reporting, and coordination that doesn't drop a candidate between steps. We're looking for a **Recruiting Operations Lead** to own that infrastructure end-to-end, and to build it right the first time, rather than retrofit in the future.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* **Own Ashby.** Configuration, workflows, integrations, and data hygiene are yours end-to-end, not a shared responsibility with whoever has time.
* **Build the reporting layer.** Funnel metrics, time-to-fill, source effectiveness, and hiring velocity, dashboards recruiters, executives, GMs, and hiring leadership use to make decisions.
* **Process design.** Turn how Beacon hires today into documented, repeatable workflows that hold up as the team and portfolio grow.
* **Coordination backbone.** Partner closely with our Recruiting Coordinator to keep scheduling, candidate communications, and interview logistics clean, especially with multiple portco searches running at once.
* **AI & automation.** Identify and deploy tooling that reduces admin burden across candidate screening and scheduling. This might branch out to other areas including sourcing, and post interview decisions and offer workflows.
* **Candidate experience.** Standardize the candidate journey across corporate and portco searches with a consistently high bar.
* **Cross-functional glue.** Work with VP of Talent and Finance on headcount planning and with legal/People partners on offer letters, background checks, and clean handoffs.
* **Data hygiene at holdco scale.** Every portfolio company's reqs, candidates, and hires need to roll up cleanly into one picture. You build that structure now, not after it's already messy.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 5+ years in recruiting operations, HR technology, or business systems administration, with real ownership of an ATS (Ashby strongly preferred).
* Comfort building process from scratch, not optimizing an existing one. Beacon's talent function is new; you'll be writing the manual, not editing it.
* A strong analytical mindset. You can build a dashboard, but more importantly, you know which metric actually changes a decision.
* Systems thinking. You can map how a change in one workflow ripples through downstream reporting and integrations before you make it.
* Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving, small-team, multi-entity environment. No two portfolio companies operate the same way.
* Excellent cross-functional communication; you'll work directly with the Talent, Department Heads/Managers, Finance, and People partners across a holding company structure.
* Bachelor's degree, or additional years of experience in lieu.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience in a PE-backed or multi-entity/holdco environment, where recruiting ops had to serve several operationally independent businesses at once.
* Experience standing up recruiting ops and systems from scratch (0-to-1), not just optimizing a mature function.
* Experience partnering with a lean recruiting coordination function to keep logistics tight without a large ops team behind you.

**Our Values at Beacon Software**

* Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time.
* Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant.
* Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected.
* Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world - compounding growth.

***How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process:*** *To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.*

***AI does not make hiring decisions:*** *Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.*

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Clinical Care
jobs.description:
**About Abby Care: Powering the future of care at home for all of America.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.  
  
We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.  
  
Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.  
  
We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

jobs.title: Patient Access Services Supervisor
jobs.description:
Under the general supervision of the Patient Access Services Manager, the Patient Access Services Supervisor is responsible for assisting in managing the operational and technical functions of the Admitting offices and other operational areas that include the Surgical Waiting Areas, BCH Emergency Department, Birthing Center, Blood Draw and Pediatric Access Unit. The BCH Emergency Department and Birthing Center are a 24/7-operation area that is staffed by both Sr. Admitting and Principal Admitting Workers. The Supervisor shares the first line responsibility for the 24/7 operations. All shifts day, evening and graveyard have to be supported equally by one culture, one set of values and more importantly one operating standard. Responsibilities include staff education and development, providing direction, sets priorities, and analyzing workflow for admitting workers, according to established policies and management guidance. Recommends, develops, and implements new and revised procedures as needed to support operations and promote a smooth patient flow. Major duties within Patient Access Services include registration for all admissions, account financial follow-up, Medi-Cal applications, financial counseling, financial assessment, and cash collections. The incumbent serves as a DNB (Discharge Not Billed) champion and is responsible for monitoring account assignments and staff follow-up. In collaboration with the Pediatric Access Center , oversees the coordination and integration of patient demographic, financial and clinical information to ensure that patients transferred to UCSF are clinically and financially assessed in accordance to practices.

The Patient Access Services Supervisor will have a critical influence on a patient’s health care experience in our Medical Center and must act as an ambassador of services. The incumbent is responsible to ensure all patients’ needs are met, demonstrate a willingness to learn new skills, and foster a harmonious work environment in which high-quality patient care and customer service are consistently provided. Promote a cooperative working relationship with each other, physicians, other disciplines and the public by facilitating and enhancing communication, displaying honesty and respect, displaying sensitivity to cultural differences, and expressing and accepting feedback in a professional manner.

The incumbent will function as an Apex power user who can use advanced features of the system to develop patient work flows and collaborate with various departments to resolve issues and ensure patient movement, which are beyond the abilities of “normal” users.

  

Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree OR a High School diploma or GED and four years of relevant experience.
* Two or more years of demonstrated supervisory, organizational, and customer service skills to effectively supervise and prioritize the activities of subordinate staff, and to manage the complex workflow and multiple priorities of admissions and registration.
* Five or more years of experience working in a health care setting, ideally in a patient access or patient financial service setting.
* Strong knowledge of medical terminology, and technical and operational principles of hospital admissions, including concepts, best practices, protocols, quality improvement, technologies, confidentiality issues, HIPAA, and other applicable regulatory policies.
* Strong skills in quality customer service. Interpersonal skills to interact and collaborate effectively with all constituent groups, including patients and families, and clinical and administrative personnel across departments.
* Strong leadership skills to coach, monitor, and strengthen staff performance. Ability to provide thorough and accurate review of complex subordinate work and to oversee coordination of ongoing tasks and projects over extended periods of time.
* Strong knowledge of all relevant policies, protocols, regulations, and organizational objectives. Strong critical thinking skills, with the ability to quickly analyze complex problems, determine appropriate level of intervention, and develop and apply solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communications skills, with the ability to effectively motivate others and to convey complex information in a clear and concise manner.
* Strong computer skills in all relevant hardware, software, and information systems.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with all levels of management, as well as with clinical care providers, administrative and business personnel, and other stakeholders on issues related to patient admissions and registration.
* Ability to work onsite full-time in San Francisco.
